info.title: TechVal AI — Scientific Technology Assessment & Economic Valuation API
info.description: Versioned REST API (/api/v1) maintaining four strictly separate outputs: Technology Assessment, Commercialization Readiness, Economic Valuation (IDR), and Evidence Completeness.

post.summary: Revise Valuation And Create Immutable Revision
post.description:
Revises financial assumptions and creates a new immutable AssessmentRevision preserving
actor, timestamp, change_reason, and previous_values_json.
Marks any prior approved ExpertReviews on the technology as `stale`.

schema.title: Response Revise Valuation And Create Immutable Revision Api V1 Valuation Revise Post
Response List Expert Reviews Api V1 Reviews  Technology Id  Get

post.description:
Allows expert reviewers to approve/reject indicators and revise scores/status with reasons.
Preserves immutable assessment revisions: creates a new AssessmentRevision with actor,
timestamp, reason, and previous_values_json.
Marks any existing approved ExpertReviews as `stale`.

schema.title: Response Expert Revise Indicators Api V1 Reviews Revise Indicators Post

post.description: Binds an expert approval/rejection to an exact AssessmentRevision.
